summary: Rehearsed on the clone's copy of production: Step 1 (Copy again and the context copy, one organization at a time) finished green, then pressed for every organization, undone with a new-system edit carried back, Step 1 again, pressed again, and undone again. Step 1's real work ran in the first pass of the same evening (25.5 min, context copies for admin's Workspace and Rincon Plumbing Co — Ojai Branch green, row locks only); four leftover test tables a clone test never archived were archived before the pass that pressed.
